title: Quick questions before I design this
lede: A phone-friendly guide to NYC-area races that helps runners see how and when to enter, save the races they care about, and never miss a registration window. It should feel like it was made by local runners, not like a generic dashboard.

questions.title: Which screen should I design first?
questions.why: Every design will show the same screen so you can compare them side by side. Your description calls discovery the start of the main journey.

options.label: Race finder
options.detail: Browse and filter upcoming races, with registration dates up front

options.label: Race detail page
options.detail: One race: entry method, deadlines, qualification, save and calendar actions

options.label: My Races
options.detail: Saved races with upcoming registration milestones and notes

questions.title: Should I design it for a phone or a computer screen?
questions.why: Your description says it should work especially well on a phone, but the setup picked desktop as the default view.

options.label: Phone
options.detail: Designed for a phone held in one hand

options.label: Computer
options.detail: A wider layout for a laptop or desktop

questions.title: What should it feel like?
questions.why: Your inspirations range from loud city streetwear to calm outdoor brands, so I'd like to know where to land.
questions.textPlaceholder: e.g. Like a race bib pinned to a club flyer

questions.title: Should race listings show photos?
questions.why: Your description doesn't say. Photos add energy but official race photos aren't always available; maps, course lines and bold type can carry the look instead.

options.label: Yes, show race photos
options.detail: A photo for each race, when there is one

options.label: No photos
options.detail: Use course maps, route lines and type instead

questions.title: How many directions should I design?
questions.why: More directions, more range; fewer, faster to compare.

questions.title: Anything else I should know?
questions.why: Optional. A race you'd want featured, a color you love or hate, anything.
questions.placeholder: e.g. Feature the Brooklyn Half and a trail ultra
